Bud Light's parent owns Modelo. So why does Constellation Brands sell it in the US?

In 2013 the DOJ cleared AB InBev's Grupo Modelo deal only if the US rights went to Constellation, which paid $2.9B for a brewery and perpetual US brand rights.
Constellation's beer net sales grew from $2.8B (FY2014) to $8.3B (FY2026), with a 38.0% operating margin.
Modelo Especial passed Bud Light in retail dollar sales in June 2023; Constellation said in October 2026 it is still No. 1 by dollars. Michelob Ultra leads by volume.
FY2026 beer sales fell 3% as shipment volumes dropped and aluminum tariffs raised costs.

Sources: Constellation Brands FY2026 and Q2 FY2027 results, 2013 deal filing; US DOJ; Circana via Fox Business, CNN.
News and education, not financial advice.
